scope: Inventory only. No automation cadence, ownership, commit, or editorial behavior changed in this step.

schedulesManila: 08:50 first day of month — monthly sources

systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before publishing state.

systems.commitBehavior: Workflow commits generated monitor state/history/report to main whenever they differ.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before publishing state.

systems.config: data/ecosystem-link-watch.json plus URLs discovered under src/content/data
systems.commitBehavior: No repository write or main-branch commit.

systems.owner: Editorial review age and declared page completeness
systems.workflow: Runs inside npm quality/build; no dedicated scheduled workflow
systems.currentRule: Every audited page must have reviewedAt and remain no more than 120 days old.
systems.limitation: Review age is independent of watched-source changes; a source may change without marking affected pages for review.

systems.owner: Published daily, weekly and monthly civic brief snapshots
schedulesManila: 09:15 first day of month — monthly brief
systems.commitBehavior: Commits a brief snapshot to main when generated output differs.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before commit.
systems.note: A rerun replaces the same brief id with a new publishedAt timestamp, so a rerun can still produce a repository change.

systems.commitBehavior: Opens/updates a reviewable pull request instead of directly committing generated news to main.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before opening/updating the PR.

generalSourceFreshnessVsCityMonitor.note: Same source is monitored with different semantics.

scheduleCollisions.risk: Both can rewrite generated state and commit to main.
Multiple build/check/commit-or-PR jobs are clustered within 30 minutes.

scheduleCollisions.condition: Monday that is also the first day of a month
scheduleCollisions.risk: Maximum automation burst and highest chance of concurrent main-branch churn.

deploymentChurn.finding: General Source Freshness and City Monitor include run timestamps/history on every execution. Their workflows commit generated files whenever changed, so an unchanged source check can still create a new main-branch commit.
deploymentChurn.consequence: Every automation commit to main can trigger another Vercel deployment, contributing to build-rate pressure even when public site content did not substantively change.
deploymentChurn.civicBriefNote: Civic Brief publication is intentionally content-producing, but repeated runs can also change publishedAt.

editorialBlindSpots: Source-change review queues identify changed/failed sources but do not identify which BetterMakati pages depend on each source.
Page freshness is based on review age, not source dependencies.
General Source Freshness and City Monitor duplicate four URLs, creating duplicate checks and potentially duplicate signals.
The PhilGEPS overlap uses different monitoring modes, so ownership and semantics need to be explicit before deduplication.
The LastReviewed component has a static fallback date; later page-freshness work should ensure missing explicit dates cannot silently look reviewed.

implementationUpdates.title: Remove automation collisions and no-op deployment churn
changes: Collapsed the three Source Freshness schedules into one 08:00 Philippine-time daily trigger.
The scheduled Source Freshness run uses cadence=due: daily sources every day, weekly sources on Mondays, monthly sources on the first day of the month.
Daily City Monitor remains at 08:30 Philippine time, separating the two freshness jobs.
General Source Freshness now sets publishRequired only when checked source status/error state changes or a content-hash baseline changes.
City Monitor now sets publishRequired only when source status/error state changes or a content-hash source changes.
Both workflows skip npm run build and skip commits to main when publishRequired is false.
Reachability-only body changes do not trigger publication.
Public Records and BetterMakati Status now label timestamps as published checks rather than implying every background run is deployed.
implementationUpdates.expectedEffect: Routine unchanged checks still execute, but they no longer create timestamp-only main-branch commits or Vercel deployments.
unchanged: Source ownership is unchanged and remains for 2.4C.
The four general-source/City-Monitor overlaps are unchanged and remain for 2.4C.
Editorial source-to-page dependency mapping remains for 2.4D.

implementationUpdates.title: Define source ownership
changes: Assigned every source-watch catalog entry to general-source-freshness or city-monitor.
Delegated Makati news, events, legislation and PhilGEPS to City Monitor.
The general freshness checker now skips City Monitor-owned sources.
PhilGEPS public catalog metadata now reflects the owner's content-hash monitoring semantics.
Public Records labels delegated sources as Monitored by City Monitor instead of Awaiting first scheduled check.
Build audits and browser tests protect the ownership split.
implementationUpdates.result: 112-source public catalog retained; 108 sources actively checked by general freshness; 4 delegated to City Monitor; no duplicate active freshness check for those four URLs.

sourceOwnership.rule: Each freshness purpose has one authoritative owner. Public catalog entries may remain visible when delegated, but the general checker skips sources owned by City Monitor.

intentionalMultiPurposeChecks.reason: Different purposes: upstream dependency availability versus user-facing outbound-link integrity.
